notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Prepared Defenses, The Phantom Menace, I Will Find Them Quickly, Master and a 'META CARD (see strategy)' slot; these count toward the 60.

The 'META CARD (see strategy)' slot is a flex starting Effect the strategy leaves to the metagame (Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, or You Cannot Hide Forever); it is printed as written and counted, so the list totals 60 and every section count matches.

Format Premiere - Coruscant: the Objective and most of the deck are Coruscant-set cards; the post does not call itself Episode I-only and plays Emperor Palpatine, Darth Vader With Lightsaber and three bounty-hunter starships.
The Dark pages are used for Coruscant: Galactic Senate, the three Naboo sites and Vote Now!; Tatooine: Desert Landing Site and Blockade Flagship: Bridge are Dark-only pages.
